Page No.# 1/5 vs Dilwar Hussain And 4 Ors A on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/86453866/

This is an appeal under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 against the Judgment & Order dated 09.11.2023 passed by the learned Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Hailakandi in MAC Case No. 285/2020, for awarding lesser amount of compensation which is due to the appellant by miscalculating the amount due.
Mr. A.K. Azad accepts notice on behalf of the respondent Nos. 1, 4 & 5.
Requisite copies of the appeal memo to be duly furnished to the learned counsel for the respondents.
Notice be issued to the remaining respondents through registered post with A/D as well as by usual process within 3 days, returnable by three weeks.
